notes.t110: gpio73=PC9 status LED (0.5s heartbeat); gpio58=PB26 WiFi IRQ; gpio62=PB30 SD-CD active-high; gpio30=PA30 reset button active-low; gpio61=PB29 SD power (active-low enable, BENCH-CONFIRMED 2026-10-26: U-Boot gpio clear 61 + mmc rescan enumerates the card; moved out of wlan seq, it was cutting SD power mid-boot); gpio60=PB28 REGON stays in wlan seq; speaker amp en gpio63. LeCam GPIOHelper set {0,46,49,50,63,73,75}: gpio46=IR LED, gpio49/50=ircut pair, gpio75=white lamp (device has light temperature+intensity profiles) - held in reserve until hardware-verified. MOTORS ARE PWM/TCU (motor.ko, pan maxstep 5300 / elev 1100, coil pins in SMHLROQP table, candidates B8/B9/B17/B18/C15/C18) - NOT GPIO; left unconfigured here pending coil-pin scope work; thingino has no motor.ko ioctl driver class yet.
notes.t110_source: Josh reverse-engineering 2026-10-22: DTS + boot logs + live QEMU + stock scripts; gpio61 SD-power correction from U-Boot bench probe 2026-10-26 (Josh). Ported to ciao 2026-10-26 (branch gino/noorio-t110-ciao): identical values as the validated master build.
